text: During a member's visit, you add charges the usual way. Scout works out what the plan covers, so the bill is right before checkout.
Remember: when Scout asks which benefit to use, pick one. Once a benefit is used up, the item is charged at the regular price.
Maple is on Canine Foundations. Click in the charge box.
The wellness visit matches two of Maple's benefits: included, with one left this year, or fifty percent off. Scout asks which to use.
Covered. The plan pays for this line.
Maple already had her distemper vaccine this year, so this one is charged at the regular price, and Scout says the allotment is used.
Today's total is just the vaccine. The wellness visit costs the family nothing.

The most common mistakes: typing a price by hand on a covered line, and closing the benefit question, which cancels the charge. Remember: when Scout asks which benefit to use, pick one. Once a benefit is used up, the item is charged at the regular price.
